data_window.timestamps: Source columns are timestamp without time zone, documented as local time. Connector JSON adds Z; dates and weeks are interpreted using source-local calendar semantics, without converting to America/Chicago or treating Z as verified UTC.

transition.note: Rollout time unknown; this week contains pre- and post-release observations.

definitions.acceptance: taken pings / all pings; pooled counts, not average of rounded percentages
definitions.callout_take_rate: callouts with at least one taken ping / all callouts; not incident resolution or capability coverage
definitions.severe_screen: Descriptive, selected after inspecting data: baseline mean >=10 offers/week AND <=1 offer in final week. It is not a causal treatment/control assignment.
definitions.zero_exposure: Keep roster-week cells with zero pings; acceptance is undefined (null), not 0%, if no offers.

limits: No historical availability windows, eligibility/capability snapshots, distances, routing scores, notification delivery events, answer timestamps, release-version field, or prior-year seasonality data.
Observed declines in offers are verified; cause, preparedness, delivery success, effort, fairness and churn are not established.
All source-table rows were retrieved; ingestion completeness outside and within source tables is not independently attested.
